description: Presenting the Regulation made under section 66 of the Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act (chapter 129), in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑07‑03 to amend the Regulation No.3 of the Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, No.19 of 1954. Accordingly, the said amended Regulation is envisaged to introduce the necessary legal amendments to enable female employees above the age of 18 years employed as Food and Beverage Stewardess in residential hotels and restaurants to work after 6.00 pm and before 6.00 am. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to submit the amended Regulation made by the Minister for that purpose under section 66 of the Shop and Office Employee (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, to Parliament for approval and thereafter to publish the same in the Government Gazette.
